text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The opposition Union Democratique Unioniste party chief expresses support for President Ben Ali's policy on democracy and human rights.
- Gross Domestic Product growth rate forecast to be 7.5 to eight percent.
- Pop Star Michael Jackson concert in Tunis on Monday night was magic.
- Economic development Minister Taoufik Baccar says 9th development planning 1997-2001 to be adopted early in 1997.
- Moroccan Trade and Handicrafts Minister says during a visit in Tunis that a Maghreb common market is vital.
